article.hook: You push forward, but it’s not with force. It’s a flicker on the edge of feeling, a move made through silence and subtlety. Mars in Pisces works behind the scenes, driving action where straight lines can’t go.
article.lived: Over the next six weeks, you’ll notice yourself acting by intuition more than plan - starting projects from a gut pull, helping without announcing, and shifting priorities because something feels off, not because a list says so. You’ll move in soft, indirect ways: offering your time to a stranger, changing your route because the light looks different, or finishing a task by weaving in others’ needs. Energy flows like water here, bending around obstacles instead of breaking them down.
article.turn: When clear boundaries fade, effort leaks out in quiet frustration, and you spend days simmering without saying what’s wrong. Compassion can turn to martyrdom - doing too much for others and burning yourself out without a word of complaint. Stop assuming people can read your mood; anger that drips instead of lands leaves everyone guessing and nothing solved.
moves: Offer help by doing, not explaining why it matters.
Set a timer to check in with how you’re feeling before starting anything new.
Write down one boundary you need and share it plainly with someone involved.
